_note: PARKED, NOT LIVE DATA. The nine Knights Radiant order trees (9 x 25 = 225 rows) that used to sit in data/cosmere.json alongside the six Edha heroic paths. Nothing in the repo has ever read them: scripts/lib/data.js buildTrees(), scripts/build-player-primer.js and scripts/validate.js all filter data/cosmere.json to the six heroic paths (Agent/Envoy/Hunter/Leader/Scholar/Warrior), so these rows were never built into a pack, never rendered in the player primer and never schema-checked. Parked here 2026-09-05 under TODO_REPO_HYGIENE #22 / ruling PM-R3 so data/cosmere.json holds only what the build consumes.
_dialect: Keys are the live lowercase dialect (path/specialty/name/action/cost/prerequisites/description/tags/atlas/layout/connections), normalised in the same pass — un-parking is a straight paste back into data/cosmere.json, no key translation.
_unpark: Append rows[] to data/cosmere.json and add the order names to HEROIC_PATHS in scripts/lib/data.js and scripts/validate.js. Every row here lacks layout and connections, so each order also needs a tree layout before it could be built (iron rule 7: a tree must be walkable).

rows.name: First Ideal - Dustbringer
rows.description: Gain Investiture score, Breathe Stormlight, Enhance, and Regenerate. When you complete the goal "Speak the First Ideal", gain Abrasion and Division skills.
rows.tags: first_ideal; gain_investiture; breathe_stormlight; enhance; regenerate; abrasion; division

rows.name: Second Ideal - Dustbringer
rows.description: When you complete the goal "Speak the Second Ideal," you become Empowered and can use Enhance as a Free Action without spending Investiture.

rows.name: Searing Dust Storm
rows.description: Spend 1 Investiture to kick up an obscuring cloud of dust as you Move. Enemies in this cloud take extra damage equal to your ranks in Discipline.

rows.name: Third Ideal - Dustbringer
rows.description: When you complete the goal "Speak the Third Ideal," you become Empowered and can manifest your spren as a Radiant Shardblade.

rows.name: Invested
rows.description: Your max Investiture increases by your tier.

rows.name: Fourth Ideal - Dustbringer
rows.description: When you complete the goal "Speak the Fourth Ideal," you become Empowered and can manifest Radiant Shardplate.

rows.name: Wound Regeneration
rows.description: When you Regenerate, spend 2 Investiture to recover from a temporary injury, or spend 3 Investiture to recover from a permanent one.

rows.name: Deepened Bond
rows.description: Your spren bond range increases to 100 ft, and givbing your spren a task costs 1 fewer focus.

rows.name: Take Squire - Dustbringer
rows.description: Choose non-Radiant characters as your squires, granting them one or both surges. They can also Breathe Stormlight, Enhance, and Regenerate. Your max number of squires equals your Ideal.

rows.name: Frictionless Motion
rows.description: While infused with Abrasion, increase your movement by 10 and ignore Slowed.

rows.name: Reverse Abrasion
rows.description: You can increase the friction of an object or area, canceling difficult terrain and giving an advantage to interact with it.

rows.name: Graceful Skating
rows.description: When you Skate and use its Move free action, you aren't restricted to moving in a straight line.

rows.name: Stormlight Reclamation
rows.description: At the start of your turn, you can end any number of infusions to regain their remaining Investiture.

rows.name: Slippery Target
rows.description: While infused with Abrasion, attacks can't graze you and Reactive Strikes against you gain a disadvantage.

rows.name: Distant Surgebinding
rows.description: Use your surges and their talents as though your reach is 20 ft.

rows.name: Slick Combatant
rows.description: While infused with Abrasion, you can interrupt a Move with other Actions. Deal extra damage on a mid-movement attack.

rows.name: Smooth Operator
rows.description: While you have Investiture, you are infused with Abrasion and it costs you 1 fewer focus to Skate.

rows.name: Bodily Decay
rows.description: When you hit with a Division attack, you can spend Opportunity to cause one target of that attack to suffer an injury.

rows.name: Eroding Escape
rows.description: Spend 1 or more Investiture to end that many effects inflicting the Restrained or Immobilized condition.

rows.name: Igniting Division
rows.description: When you use Division, spend 1 or more Investiture to light the target's space on fire, dealing ongoing damage equal to your Division modifier.

rows.name: Spark Sending
rows.description: When there's a solid survace between you and target, use Division as though your reach is 20 ft.

rows.name: Gout of Flame
rows.description: Spend 3 Investiture to make a Division attack vs. Physical against each taret in an area one size larger than normal.

rows.name: Inescapable Spark
rows.description: Your Spark Sending now extends to your spren bond range. You don't need line of effect when you can sense your target, and they can't Brace against your Division.

rows.name: Devastating Division
rows.description: When you roll damage for Division, roll an additional damage die.

rows.name: Unleashed Entropy
rows.description: It costs you one fewer Action to use the Division skill. Your Division Under Pressure DC is reduced by 5.

rows.name: Soulcast Defense
rows.description: Before you or an ally is hit by a projectile, spend 1 Investiture to test Transformation (DC equals triggering attack). On failure, the projectile grazes. On success, the projectile misses and becomes an Essence.

rows.name: Living Soulcasting
rows.description: Spend 1 Investiture and make a melee Transformation attack vs. Spiritual of a living organism, rolling 3d4 spirit damage. The target dies if reduced to 0 health.

rows.name: Soulcast Parry
rows.description: You can use Soulcast Defense on melee weapon attacks

rows.name: Bloodcasting
rows.description: Spend 1 Investiture and test Transformation (DC 15) to cleanse all poison from the target and reduce one injury's recovery time by 5 days.

rows.name: Distant Surgebinding
rows.description: Use your surges and their talents as though your reach is 20 ft.

rows.name: Flamecasting
rows.description: You gain "Flame" as a sixth category following "Clear Air" (DC 30 to transform stone to flame). When Soulcasting flames, attack each character within 5 ft using Transformation vs. Physical, rolling 2d4 energy damage.

rows.name: Persistent Transformation
rows.description: When transforming non-living objects, your max DC is 15. Also, you can reattempt Soulcasting, but on a success, must spend 1 additional Investiture per recent Soulcasting failure.

rows.name: Expansive Transmuter
rows.description: Soulcasting non-living material costs 2 fewer Investiture

rows.name: Cognitive Farsight
rows.description: You can spot things in the Cognitive Realm up to a distance equal to 3 x your spren bond range. While you have Investiture, you can identify north and the direction to the nearest settlement.

rows.name: Realmic Evasion
rows.description: Before you're hit by an attack, spend 1 Investiture and test Transportation (DC equals triggering attack). On failure, the attack grazes. On success, the attack misses.

rows.name: Cognitive Vision
rows.description: When you use Transportation to look into the Cognitive Realm, you can learn an enemy's intent by testing Transportation vs. Cognitive, and you can learn about your immediate environment.

rows.name: Realmic Step
rows.description: Test Transportation (DC 15) and spend 2 Investiture to transport yourself to a space within spren bond range.

rows.name: Shared Transportation
rows.description: When you transport yourself, spend 1 investiture or more to bring that many additional characters with you.

rows.name: Elsecalling
rows.prerequisites: Realmic Step; Speak the Third Ideal
rows.description: Spend 1 Investiture to transport yourself from the Physical to the Cognitive Realm, or test Transportation (DC 20) and spend 2 Investiture to transport from the Cognitive to the Physical Realm.

rows.name: Elsegate
rows.prerequisites: Shared Transportation; Speak the Fourth Ideal
rows.description: Transport yourself and up to ten companions to an Oathgate or permanent perpendicularity you've visited before.

rows.name: Realmwalker
rows.description: When you test Transportation for a talent, you automatically succeed.

rows.name: Flying Ace
rows.description: Fly up to your gravitation rate, which permanently increases to 40 ft. You can spend 1 focus to make a melee weapon attack during this flight.

rows.name: Gravitational Slam
rows.description: Use a Basic Lashing to collide a target with a solid surface, dealing 1d4 impact damage per 10 ft moved. The target can Avoid Danger to halve damage.

rows.name: Surface Tension

rows.name: Multiplicative Lightweaving
rows.description: You can Lightweave additional illusions, up to your ranks in Illumination, with no additional Investiture.

rows.name: Painful Truth
rows.description: Spend 2 Investiture and test Illumination vs. Spiritual of a target. On success, they are Slowed and must Move away on their next turn or spend focus to avoid doing so.

rows.name: Endless Illusions
rows.description: You can maintain illusions indefinitely. While you have Investiture, Illumination infusions in your spren bond range don't expend Investiture.

rows.name: First Ideal - Willshaper
rows.description: Gain Investiture score and the Breathe Stormlight, Enhance, and Regenerate Actions. When you complete the goal "Speak the First Ideal," you become Empowered and gain Cohesion and Transportation.

rows.name: Second Ideal - Willshaper
rows.description: When you complete the goal "Speak the Second Ideal," you become Empowered and can use Enhance as a Free Action without spending Investiture.

rows.name: Spiritual Cohesion
rows.description: Choose allies up to your current Ideal to become Determined. Opportunity from that condition increases that ally's Cognitive and Spiritual defenses by 2.

rows.name: Invested
rows.description: Your max Investiture increases by your tier.

rows.name: Third Ideal - Willshaper
rows.description: When you complete the goal "Speak the Third Ideal," you becomed Empowered and can manifest your spren as a Radiant Shardblade.

rows.name: Wound Regeneration
rows.description: When you Regenerate, spend 2 Investiture to recover from a temporary injury, or spend 3 Investiture to recover from a permanent one.

rows.name: Fourth Ideal - Willshaper
rows.description: When you complete the goal "Speak the Fourth Ideal," you become Empowered and can manifest Radiant Shardplate.

rows.name: Deepened Bond
rows.description: Your spren bond range increases to 100 ft, and givbing your spren a task costs 1 fewer focus.

rows.name: Take Squire - Willshaper
rows.description: Choose non-Radiant characters as your squires, granting them one or both surges. They can also Breathe Stormlight, Enhance, and Regenerate. Your max number of squires equals your Ideal.

rows.name: Cognitive Farsight
rows.description: You can spot things in the Cognitive Realm up to a distance equal to 3 x your spren bond range. While you have Investiture, you can identify north and the direction to the nearest settlement.

rows.name: Realmic Evasion
rows.description: Before you're hit by an attack, spend 1 Investiture and test Transportation (DC equals triggering attack). On failure, the attack grazes. On success, the attack misses.

rows.name: Cognitive Vision
rows.description: When you use Transportation to look into the Cognitive Realm, you can learn an enemy's intent by testing Transportation vs. Cognitive, and you can learn about your immediate environment.

rows.name: Realmic Step
rows.description: Test Transportation (DC 15) and spend 2 Investiture to transport yourself to a space within spren bond range.

rows.name: Shared Transportation
rows.description: When you transport yourself, spend 1 investiture or more to bring that many additional characters with you.

rows.name: Elsecalling
rows.prerequisites: Realmic Step; Speak the Third Ideal
rows.description: Spend 1 Investiture to transport yourself from the Physical to the Cognitive Realm, or test Transportation (DC 20) and spend 2 Investiture to transport from the Cognitive to the Physical Realm.

rows.name: Elsegate
rows.prerequisites: Shared Transportation; Speak the Fourth Ideal
rows.description: Transport yourself and up to ten companions to an Oathgate or permanent perpendicularity you've visited before.

rows.name: Realmwalker
rows.description: When you test Transportation for a talent, you automatically succeed.

rows.name: Stone Spear
rows.description: Spend 1 Investiture to make a ranged Cohesion attack vs. Physical of a target within 60 ft, rolling 2d4 impact damage.

rows.name: Memories of Stone
rows.description: Spend 1 Investiture to communicate with stone you're touching. If this requires interpretation, test Cohesion (DC determined by the GM).

rows.name: Sinkhole
rows.description: Spend 1 Investiture and test Cohesion vs. Cognitive of chosen targets on stone ground. On success, the target sinks into the ground and is Immobilized.

rows.name: Tunneling
rows.description: Spend 1 Investiture to move through stone as if through difficult terrain, leaving a 5 ft tunnel behind you.

rows.name: Through Stone
rows.description: Use your surges and their talents as though your reach is 20 ft.

rows.name: True Stoneshaping
rows.description: Intricately and extensively shape stone without using additional actions or time.

rows.name: Unbound Cohesion
rows.description: Use Cohesion on any solid material that isn't alive, Invested, or infused with Stormlight.

rows.name: Flowing Earth
rows.description: After using Cohesion, shape the stone beneath your feet, pushing yourself in any direction up to 5 ft x your ranks in Cohesion.

rows.name: First Ideal - Windrunner
rows.description: Gain Investiture score and the Breathe Stormlight, Enhance, and Regenerate Actions. When you complete the goal "Speak the First Ideal," you become Empowered and gain Adhesion and Gravitation.

rows.name: Second Ideal - Windrunner
rows.description: When you complete the goal "Speak the Second Ideal," you become Empowered and can use Enhance as a Free Action without spending Investiture.

rows.name: Reverse Lashing
rows.description: Infuse a target with a Reverse Lashing using Adhesion, then choose one type of object to attrack; the infused target attracts those objects in a distance equal to your gravitation rate.

rows.name: Invested
rows.description: Your max Investiture increases by your tier.

rows.name: Third Ideal - Windrunner
rows.description: When you complete the goal "Speak the Third Ideal," you becomed Empowered and can manifest your spren as a Radiant Shardblade.

rows.name: Wound Regeneration
rows.description: When you Regenerate, spend 2 Investiture to recover from a temporary injury, or spend 3 Investiture to recover from a permanent one.

rows.name: Fourth Ideal - Windrunner
rows.description: When you complete the goal "Speak the Fourth Ideal," you become Empowered and can manifest Radiant Shardplate.

rows.name: Deepened Bond
rows.description: Your spren bond range increases to 100 ft, and givbing your spren a task costs 1 fewer focus.

rows.name: Take Squire - Windrunner
rows.description: Choose non-Radiant characters as your squires, granting them one or both surges. They can also Breathe Stormlight, Enhance, and Regenerate. Your max number of squires equals your Ideal.

rows.name: Stormlight Reclamation
rows.description: End Adhesion infusions within reach and recover their remaining Investiture.

rows.name: Binding Strike
rows.description: When you hit with a melee attack, spend Opportunity or 2 focus to infuse Adhesion into an object the target is holding or wearing.

rows.name: Distant Surgebinding
rows.description: Use your surges and their talents as though your reach is 20 ft.

rows.name: Binding Shot
rows.description: You can use Binding Strike when you are hit with a ranged attack.

rows.name: Extended Adhesion
rows.description: Your Full Lashings only expend 1 Investiture per number of rounds equal to your ranks in Adhesion.

rows.name: Adhesive Trap
rows.description: You can infuse Adhesion into surfaces. Characters who touch the infused surface become Fully Lashed to it.

rows.name: Living Adhesion
rows.description: You can use Adhesion on characters. When Lashed to something larger, they are Restrained, their physical tests gain a disadvantage, and attacks against them gain advantage.

rows.name: Superior Bond
rows.description: Automatically succeed on an opposed test to maintain Full Lashings against characters with Strength no higher than your ranks in Adhesion.

rows.name: Flying Ace
rows.description: Fly up to your gravitation rate, which permanently increases to 40 ft. You can spend 1 focus to make a melee weapon attack during this flight.

rows.name: Gravitational Slam
rows.description: Use a Basic Lashing to collide a target with a solid surface, dealing 1d4 impact damage per 10 ft moved. The target can Avoid Danger to halve damage.

rows.name: Stable Flight
rows.description: While maintaining a Basic Lashing on yourself, your ranged attacks don't gain a disadvantage due to flying or unstable footing.

rows.name: Multiple Lashings
rows.description: When you move an unwilling character with Gravitation, you can infuse Investiture up to your ranks in Gravitation to prolong the effect.

rows.name: Group Flight
rows.description: When you use a Basic Lashing out of combat, infuse additional characters up to your ranks in Gravitation without spending additional Investiture.

rows.name: Lashing Shot
rows.description: Propel an object at a target, spending Investiture equal to distance divided by gravitation rate. Make a ranged Gravitation attack vs. Physical, rolling 2d4 impact damage.

rows.name: Aerial Squadron
rows.description: You can use your Group Flight in combat.

rows.name: Master of the Skies
rows.description: While you have Investiture, you're always infused with Gravitation
